description: This is a PHP test class for the CandidateHiringAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains unit tests for API endpoints related to candidate hiring operations, including methods for testing getOne, update, and delete functionalities, as well as their validation rules.

classes.name: CandidateHiringAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for CandidateHiringAPI, testing its CRUD operations and validation rules in the context of OrangeHRM's recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating the CandidateHistory table.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of CandidateHiringAPI to ensure it throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the getOne method, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update operation for CandidateHiringAPI using a data provider for different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides multiple test cases for the update method, loaded from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete operation of CandidateHiringAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for the delete method, expecting a not implemented exception.
